title: Asking for another subscription
body:
I’ve been enjoying the app until all of a sudden it’s telling me to pay for premium and it is delisting my habits
The thing is that few days ago or so I paid for premium I don’t know why it’s pestering me to pay for premium again
I also restored purchase it’s not helping
author: Leoo.p

title: I’m not impressed
body: I’ve used the paid version for about 2 months and I’m not impressed at all. My streak from the day before always interferes with the current day. I’d usually have to force close and restart the app to get my real count for the day. Please fix it. It’s so annoying
author: olivemodi
